description: This file defines a utility enum 'ToolResultTextFormatter' with static methods for parsing, interpreting, and formatting JSON and string data related to tool results, including error handling, node summaries, and message rendering.

classes.name: ToolResultTextFormatter
classes.description: A utility enum providing static methods for formatting tool result texts, handling JSON parsing, error messages, and node summaries.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Main entry point to format the input text, detects JSON content, and renders it accordingly.

methods.name: looksLikeJSON
methods.description: Checks if the input string appears to be JSON based on its first character.

methods.name: renderJSON
methods.description: Processes JSON data to generate a string representation, handling dictionaries and arrays.

methods.name: renderDictionary
methods.description: Renders a JSON dictionary, handling error states, messages, and specialized node summaries based on tool name.

methods.name: renderNodesSummary
methods.description: Creates a summary string for a list of nodes extracted from JSON, showing details for each node.

methods.name: pairingDetail
methods.description: Determines if a node requires pairing based on its status or state fields.

methods.name: firstString
methods.description: Utility for extracting the first non-empty string value for a set of keys from a dictionary.

methods.name: sanitizeError
methods.description: Cleans up error message strings by removing sensitive info, trimming, and truncating long messages.
